gloss: to finish eating; to eat everything; to clean one's plate

definitions.gloss: to finish eating everything; to eat it all; to clean one's plate
definitions.explanation: To eat all of a dish or meal without leaving anything. Often used when the portion was large or challenging.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大盛|おおも}り→大盛り：08162_oomori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{完食|かんしょく}した。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{給食|きゅうしょく}→給食：13800_kyuushoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{完食|かんしょく}して⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}んだ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: The teacher was happy that the children ate all of their school lunch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{多|おお}すぎて⟦{完食|かんしょく}→完食：12346_kanshoku⟧⟦できなかった→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: There was too much food and I couldn't finish it all.

notes:
{完食|かんしょく}する is a relatively modern word that has become common through food blogs, restaurant reviews, and social media. It combines {完|かん} (complete) and {食|しょく} (eat). It often carries a sense of accomplishment, especially when the portion was large.

USAGE:
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{完食|かんしょく}する: to eat all of ~
- {完食|かんしょく}できる/⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: to be able to / unable to finish eating

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大盛|おおも}り→大盛り：08162_oomori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{完食|かんしょく}する: to finish a large portion
- ⟦{完食|かんしょく}→完食：12346_kanshoku⟧⟦{必須|ひっす}→必須：12516_hissu⟧: must eat everything (restaurant rule)
- ⟦{完食|かんしょく}→完食：12346_kanshoku⟧⟦チャレンジ→チャレンジ：11013_charenji⟧: eating challenge (to finish a huge dish)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧きる: to eat up completely — native Japanese equivalent, more casual
- {平|たい}らげる: to eat up; to polish off — implies eating with gusto, slightly informal
- ⟦{残|のこ}さ→残す：01975_nokosu⟧ず⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat without leaving anything — descriptive phrase rather than a single word
